your_name: label for voter name input field
live_results: badge shown when poll is still open
back_to_poll: link to return to voting form
section: default label for untitled section headers
other_option: shown before text input for "other" option
rule: generic column header for rule name in comparison tables
option: column header for poll choices (e.g., parties in apportionment)
candidate: column header in multi-winner election results
count: column header showing how many voting rules selected a candidate
rules: column header listing which voting rules selected a candidate
committee_size_label: inline label with committee size, e.g., "(size 5)"
report_type_distribution_aggregation: aggregates voter point distributions into consensus
add_analysis: button to add a new report
make_public: tooltip to show report to voters
make_private: tooltip to hide report from voters
median_interval: shown when there are multiple median options (even number of voters)
dist_rule_mean: simple average of all voter distributions
dist_rule_median: moving phantom mechanism with uniform phantom progression
dist_rule_independent_markets: moving phantom mechanism modeling independent market shares
dist_rule_ladder: moving phantom mechanism with ladder-shaped progression
percentage: column header for distribution results table
poll_admin: breadcrumb link to the poll admin panel
saved_view_dashboard: Save-draft success toast, followed by a separate dashboard link. Keep this message plain text.
view_dashboard: Link label in the save-draft success toast.
interface_language: Accessible label for the site interface language selector; independent of the poll language.
change_language: Accessible label for the button that applies the selected interface language.
request_failed: Fallback API error when the server provides no error message.
response_updated: Confirmation shown to a voter after editing a previously submitted response.
